name: Transparent Nav that Solidifies on Scroll
note: One registered number, --bkn-solid-p, is animated by animation-timeline: scroll() on the page's own scroller over a calc() range tied to the hero height; background, blur, text colour, hairline and CTA fill are all color-mix() derivations of it, so the nav turns solid exactly as the hero leaves — with a rAF scroll fallback writing the same number where scroll timelines are missing.
